rationales.seed_blocks: The four frozen public analysis-plan blocks are used exactly; the fresh 32-world sensitivity block remains below 800000.
rationales.formation_coefficients: The coefficients are the centers of the design priors frozen before sealing, so the implementation instantiates the preregistered attainable profile without reading schedule surfaces.
rationales.formation_evidence_temperature: Unit temperature preserves the declared likelihood scale and avoids post-inference calibration.
rationales.formation_slice_log_bayes_cap: A symmetric 0.35-nat likelihood-increment bound gives a mathematical posterior-step ceiling below the frozen 0.12 maximum.
rationales.theta_support: Five symmetric prevalence points span the frozen low/high factorial while keeping exact Cartesian inference auditable.
rationales.eta_support: The support contains an exact zero spike, two partial values, a high value, and exact prevention at one.
rationales.efficacy_candidate_prior: The exact irrelevant mass is 0.35 and the remaining 0.65 follows the public dummy slab weights, preserving finite complexity accounting.
rationales.structure_theta_priors: Mirror-image broad priors let persistent and transient candidates share D while differing only in declared prevalence expectations.
rationales.outcome_reliability: The full, attenuated, and censored values are frozen in the public dummy bundle; censored observations are candidate-constant.
rationales.cue_reliability: A dimensionless 0.90 cue channel is diagnostic without making D directly observed.
rationales.relief_prior: Beta(2,2) is the prior used in the frozen prior-predictive policy calculation.
rationales.maintenance_initial_persistent_probabili: The maintenance subclaim conditions on an established organization after the preregistered formation-guaranteeing prelude.
rationales.formation_prelude_probability: A continuous 0.90 posterior is above both frozen prelude thresholds without a boolean formation write.
